notes.title: Nominate NOBK Overlay for the Steam Awards
notes.content:
Hey guys,

It’s that time of year—the Steam Autumn Sale is live, and the 2024 Steam Awards are heating up!

NOBK Overlay was undoubtedly one of the biggest games of 2024. This unique masterpiece, featuring every type of game imaginable, truly deserves the Game of the Year award. That's why we're counting on all of you to cast your votes!

Thank you for your support!
